oneLine: Investor exits DASNAC generating 550 crore in cash proceeds

sources.title: From ₹201 crore invested in 2017 to ₹550 crore realised: WSIB-backed investor exits DASNAC

synopsis: Kautilya Finance, a real estate investment platform backed by the Washington State Investment Board, has exited its non-convertible debenture investments in Delhi-based developer DASNAC. The exit generated aggregate cash proceeds of around 550 crore rupees in FY26, concluding a multi-year investment relationship that began in 2017 when Kautilya Finance BV committed 201 crore rupees to listed NCDs issued by DASNAC's special-purpose vehicle, E-Homes Infrastructure. The proceeds include repayments of invested principal and contractual interest. Additionally, DASNAC and Aevitas have held preliminary discussions on a potential equity investment, though no final agreement has been reached.
